cover_headline: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses Rs 100 Crore Worldwide Ahead of Release
facts: Reported pre-sales stand at approximately Rs 105 crore worldwide, two days before the November 5 release
Nearly 15 lakh tickets have been sold across India, including Rs 27 crore for opening day
Overseas bookings reached $5 million by Tuesday morning, including more than $1.5 million from US paid previews

end.headline: Ramayana Advance Booking Crosses Rs 100 Crore Worldwide Ahead of Release
end.line: The two-part film directed by Nitesh Tiwari opens in cinemas on November 5, 2026.
